verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running Claude on a schedule for recurring maintenance such as overnight CI failure analysis and weekly dependency audits, plus scheduling recurring tasks and cloud sessions. They also document event triggers: automatic review on every PR, CI via GitHub Actions/GitLab, @Claude in Slack returning a PR, and MCP channels reacting to webhook events while you're away. Sandboxed Bash further supports unattended execution. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on scheduling/trigger configuration and always-on hosting (evidence is mostly overview-level snippets), and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous scheduled fix workflows.
